name: 72751 · Pea Ridge, AR
findings: ZIP 72751 (Pea Ridge) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72751 (Pea Ridge) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
